title: Overwatch launches Midseason 5 update with new events, skins
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Overwatch rolled out its Midseason 5 update on Nov. 4, 2026 introducing new in-game events, character skins, shop bundles and returning in-game activities ahead of the season’s…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Overwatch rolled out its Midseason 5 update on Nov. 4, 2026 introducing new in-game events, character skins, shop bundles and returning in-game activities ahead of the season’s conclusion.
The update kicks off the five-week Taking Reign event, which runs until Dec. 7 and offers 24 reward tiers that players can unlock by completing matches and challenges.
Among the available rewards are the Epic Sigma skin recolor through the Free Pass, as well as the Legendary Resurgence Doomfist skin and Vendetta’s new Heroic Weapon through the Event Pass.

The update also introduces an Overwatch x EVE Protocol collaboration that’s available until Nov. 17.
The collaboration features five character skins, Widowmaker as EVE, D.Va as Lily, Freja as Raven, Vendetta as Tachy, and Soldier: 76 as Adam.
Roadhog’s Mythic Necrotic Knight skin also arrives with four customizable levels.

Players can take advantage of the Black Friday Vault sale, lasting until Dec. 7 and brings back previously released cosmetics through various bundles, including the Peak Mega Bundle, Hero Spotlight Bundles, and StarCraft Mega Bundle.
Alongside the new cosmetics and limited-time offers, several events are also returning throughout the remainder of the season.
Players can revisit the Excavation Initiative until Dec. 7, followed by Junkrat’s Loot Hunt from Nov. 21 to 23, offering up to nine Loot Boxes and double XP.
Competitive and Quick Play Drives will also return from Dec. 4 to 7, featuring separate progression tracks for both game modes. (By David Buenaventura, INQUIRER.net Intern)
